item.title: Bus Stop Litter Issue, 9th August
item.description:
This bus stop on Bromley Road constantly has a large amount of litter dumped behind the shelter (and on the wall behind it). The problem is there is no public litter bin at this stop, or the stop on the other side of the road. The nearest public litter bin is all the way down by the traffic light junction and shops at the end of Manor Road, or up by the chemist in the parade of shops past Chancery Lane. Could a public litter bin be installed at this bus stop? This stretch of road could really use a bin.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 60, Bromley Road, Beckenham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Railings for no reason, 9th August
item.description:
There are 2 sets of railings on Derwent Grove that were put in next to large trees. The railings are more dangerous for drivers and pedestrians than the trees. We have nearly scraped our car door on the railing several times and I can see someone wanting to sue if that happened. In addition I have tripped on the edge of the railing, there is no common sense reason for these railings. Please remove them as a priority.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 32, Derwent Grove, East Dulwich, Greater London
